name: kitsuvo
description: Less AI, less Slop. Browse with Kitsuvo, inspect AI-built evidence, and check responsive layouts. Requires the Kitsuvo desktop browser.

interface.longDescription: Less AI, less Slop. First no-AI web browser. Use your Kitsuvo desktop browser to navigate sites, read page text, interact with accessible elements, and inspect the evidence behind AI-built, slop, and impersonation verdicts. Check phone and tablet layouts. Automation uses a separate browser profile by default. Requires Kitsuvo installed on this computer; cloud clients need the local MCP bridge and Secure MCP Tunnel.
defaultPrompt: Open this site in Kitsuvo and explain its detection evidence.
Check this page at phone and desktop sizes.
